2026_04_DEN_SF.headline: Denver tests a banged-up San Francisco roster at Levi’s Stadium
2026_04_DEN_SF.paragraph1: Denver heads to Santa Clara after beating the Rams, while San Francisco is managing injuries to several important contributors after its narrow win over Arizona. The Broncos can make the game uncomfortable by forcing longer passing downs and testing a 49ers offense whose personnel availability bears watching. San Francisco still has the schematic answers to create yards after the catch, so Denver’s tackling and edge discipline matter. The 49ers’ defensive front must keep Denver from turning a balanced script into sustained drives.
2026_04_DEN_SF.model_rationale: San Francisco’s injury management raises the importance of depth and execution, while Denver’s best route is to stay balanced and force the 49ers to defend extended drives.
